_doc: SCHOOL-PLAYGROUND (Tom, 12 November): bought Cosmos playground pieces at the Caliche school (S47TownSites FDress; the meshes by Tools/cosmosplayground, git-ignored under /Game/Licensed/CosmosPlayground, loaded only if present). at: the site's metres [x east, z south] from the school's spot (road x 48, z 2245) where the bottom centre of the piece's turned and scaled bounds goes on the land; the playground's ground is x -28 to -5, z 16 to 30, its fence along z 29 and x -6 with gaps at x -15 to -12 and z 20 to 23. yaw: Unreal degrees on top of the site's (0: the mesh's +X east, +Y south). collide: a walk block from its bounds. replaces: the group of the stand-in boxes that goes unseen when the piece is here (swings, merry, seesaw, monkey, benches). The packs have no swing set and no see-saw: the swings stay as boxes. Not read by S47Props.
